The model's chin and lower jaw enter the top edge of the frame. It does not obstruct or compete with the collar or the front edge, and the placket/collar assembly remains the dominant subject.

Same throat location and same function; offset is within the tolerance of translating a flat to a worn three-dimensional collar.
